Alarm Rationalization by Kymera.author: Kymera
Alarm Rationalization by Kymera.desc: Robust solution designed to ensure compliance with ISA 18.2 and IEC62682 directives. This module simplifies the alarm management process by offering comprehensive features. It facilitates easy identification of all configured alarms, whether local or remote, through the Gateway Area Network (GAN).
Alarm Rationalization by Kymera.name: Alarm Rationalization

InfluxDB History Provider by Kymera.author: Kymera
InfluxDB History Provider by Kymera.desc: Kymera’s InfluxDB Module was developed to enable the use of InfluxDB as a storage backend to Ignition’s tag historian. The module facilitates both the historization of tag data and the querying of the history set from within Ignition for the purposes of charting and reporting. Data is inserted into a custom schema designed to best leverage InfluxDB’s efficiencies.
InfluxDB History Provider by Kymera.name: InfluxDB History Provider

Map Panel Module by Kymera.author: Kymera
Map Panel Module by Kymera.desc: The Kymera Map Panel module provides the ability to display and interact with maps from a series of map providers based on OpenStreetMap tiles. Create dynamic map applications inside of Ignition with points of interest, routes, and 2D drawn shapes through the drag-and-drop Map Panel component and many scriptable extension points.
Map Panel Module by Kymera.name: Map Panel Module

Office Document Module by Kymera.author: Kymera
Office Document Module by Kymera.desc: The Kymera Office Document module adds script functions that allow datasets to be exported to Excel files, both in .xls and .xlsx formats. This will allow your customers to easily use the tools they are already familiar with to view, manage, and analyze their data.
Office Document Module by Kymera.name: Office Document Module

Pinger Driver New by Kymera.author: Kymera
Pinger Driver New by Kymera.desc: The Kymera Pinger Driver exposes the connectivity status and last successful ping time of devices reachable from the Ignition server as tags. With this tool you can monitor network health, visualize the effects of changing parameters, and tweak your setup for the perfectly optimized solution.
Pinger Driver New by Kymera.name: Pinger Driver New

SNMP Driver by Kymera.author: Kymera
SNMP Driver by Kymera.desc: The Kymera SNMP Driver retrieves data from SNMP V1, V2c and V3 agents making it available via OPC so that Ignition and other OPC-UA compliant systems can monitor network health and computer statistics. In addition to standard SNMP functionality, v1 Traps and v2c Notifications can be handled within customizable scripts within Ignition.
SNMP Driver by Kymera.name: SNMP Driver

Socket Event Handler by Kymera.author: Kymera
Socket Event Handler by Kymera.desc: The Kymera Socket Event Handler module allows you to configure and write flexible scripts that are executed when data is received by a socket. As you are able to define the incoming packet's data, the scripts to be executed in Ignition, and the outgoing packet's data, the possibilities are endless.
Socket Event Handler by Kymera.name: Socket Event Handler

Twilio Notification Module by Kymera.author: Kymera
Twilio Notification Module by Kymera.desc: The next step in flexible and affordable alarm notifications. The Kymera Twilio Notification module enables scripts and alarms to text or call out to individuals and groups, handle the responses via scripting, and authenticate to shelve or acknowledge the alarm conveniently from your phone.
Twilio Notification Module by Kymera.name: Twilio Notification Module

Utility Scripts Module by Kymera.author: Kymera
Utility Scripts Module by Kymera.desc: The Kymera Utility Scripts module exposes a number of scripting and expression functions for use with the Ignition platform. This includes dynamic alert popups, numerous functions for statistics calculations (mean, median, standard deviation, ect.), downloading byte streams from URLs, and more.
Utility Scripts Module by Kymera.name: Utility Scripts Module

Verizon EMAG Module by Kymera.author: Kymera
Verizon EMAG Module by Kymera.desc: The Kymera Verizon EMAG module provides Ignition integration with your Verizon Enterprise Messaging service. Couple your Alarm Notifications with this module for a truly large scale messaging and message management solution.
Verizon EMAG Module by Kymera.name: Verizon EMAG Module

Web Store and Forward by Kymera.author: Kymera
Web Store and Forward by Kymera.desc: The Kymera Web Store and Forward module enables efficient Store and Forward functionality between gateways over the web. The use of Google's Protocol Buffer serialization reduces both the space required to store the data and the bandwidth required to forward it. Best used by those looking to save resources in their industrial automation network.
Web Store and Forward by Kymera.display: Web Store and Forward by Kymera
Web Store and Forward by Kymera.name: Web Store and Forward

WhatsApp Notification Module by Kymera.author: Kymera
WhatsApp Notification Module by Kymera.desc: Kymera Systems has developed a specialized module that seamlessly integrates WhatsApp with the Ignition by Inductive Automation system. This module enables the sending and acknowledgment of alarm notifications through WhatsApp messenger, providing a robust solution for real-time communication.
WhatsApp Notification Module by Kymera.name: WhatsApp Notification Module

def find_item_by_key_value(my_list, key, value):
		for item in my_list:
			if item.get(key) == value:
				return item
		return None
	vendor='TPM'
	modules=value['modules']
	instances=[]
	for module in modules:
		json=system.util.jsonDecode(system.util.jsonEncode(modules[module]))
		json['enabled']=True
		json['delete']=True
		instances.append(json)
	return instances

onChange.script:
drop=self.getSibling("Dropdown").props.value
	if drop is not None:
		selected=system.util.jsonDecode(system.util.jsonEncode(self.view.custom.modules[self.getSibling("Dropdown").props.value]))
		new=system.util.jsonDecode(system.util.jsonEncode(self.props.params.input))
		if selected is not None and new is not None and selected!=new and new['name'] not in [None,''] and new['author'] not in [None,'']:
			
			modules=system.util.jsonDecode(system.util.jsonEncode(self.view.custom.modules))
			newDisplay=new['display']
			selectedDisplay=selected['display']
			if newDisplay not in modules.keys():
				del modules[selectedDisplay]
				self.getSibling("Dropdown").props.value=newDisplay
			modules[newDisplay]=new
			self.view.custom.modules=modules
